description: This file manages session usage updates, including calculating costs, updating session store entries, and handling session-related parameters for an AI or language model system.

methods.name: applyCliSessionIdToSessionPatch
methods.description: Applies CLI session ID or binding to a session patch, updating session entries accordingly.

methods.name: resolveNonNegativeNumber
methods.description: Ensures a number is non-negative and finite, returning undefined otherwise.

methods.name: estimateSessionRunCostUsd
methods.description: Calculates the estimated USD cost of a session run based on usage and model cost configuration.

methods.name: persistSessionUsageUpdate
methods.description: Asynchronously updates session store entries with usage data, costs, and session parameters, handling various usage scenarios.
